tasks.name: Show Workspace Info
tasks.command: echo Toide example workspace is ready.

tasks.name: Build Example
tasks.command: call ..\..\qt6.7-env.cmd >nul && (mkdir build 2>nul & where g++ && g++ --version && g++ -std=gnu++2a -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude src\main.cpp src\greeting.cpp -o build\hello_toide.exe && echo Built build\hello_toide.exe)

tasks.name: Run Example
tasks.command: call ..\..\qt6.7-env.cmd >nul && if exist build\hello_toide.exe (build\hello_toide.exe) else (echo Missing build\hello_toide.exe. Run Build Example first. && exit /b 1)

tasks.name: Build Diagnostics Demo
tasks.command: call ..\..\qt6.7-env.cmd >nul && (mkdir build 2>nul & where g++ && g++ --version && g++ -std=gnu++2a -Wall -Wextra diagnostics\diagnostic_demo.cpp -o build\diagnostic_demo.exe)
